name: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

angles.text: The quest marks a notable victory and defensive statement against Alliance encroachments, while raising concerns about protecting vital Horde trade and civilian routes.
The outcome serves as a stern warning from Horde forces against mounting Alliance presence and provocations along the eastern coast.

faq.answer: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected is a Horde task involving rising cross-faction friction along the eastern coast, following the destruction of a roadside tavern along a vital travel route.
faq.q: What is Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected about?

faq.answer: Horde leadership remains highly skeptical that Horde forces were responsible. Too many Horde civilians depend on that route for trade and everyday passage, making its destruction counterproductive.
faq.q: Did the Horde destroy the tavern?

faq.answer: The tavern sits along an important thoroughfare relied upon heavily by civilian travelers and merchants for trade and movement, making its disruption a strategic concern.
faq.q: Why does the destroyed tavern matter to the Horde?

faq.answer: What first caused the tensions is unclear. Friction between the Horde and Alliance has been mounting along the eastern coast for some time, with conflict now reaching Horde territory.
faq.q: What caused tensions on the eastern coast?

faq.answer: The action represents a tactical victory that delivers a stern warning to the Alliance, demonstrating that territorial incursions against Horde interests will not go unanswered.
faq.q: What message does this outcome send to the Alliance?

faq.answer: Because the circumstances surrounding the tavern's ruin remain suspicious and civilian passage is threatened, further investigation is sought to uncover who truly caused the destruction.
faq.q: Is there further investigation into the tavern's destruction?

sections.body: As friction between the Horde and the Alliance steadily mounts along the eastern coast, skirmishes have begun creeping directly into contested territories. The destruction of a local tavern along a major thoroughfare has brought these tensions to a head, threatening ordinary travel and regional stability.
sections.title: Friction on the Coast

sections.body: Although suspicions initially pointed toward Horde aggression, local leadership doubts their own forces were behind the tavern's ruin. The thoroughfare serves as a critical artery for Horde civilians and merchants moving goods, giving the Horde every reason to keep the path open and prompting calls for a deeper look into who really destroyed it.
sections.title: Doubt and Disruption

sections.body: Despite lingering questions regarding the tavern itself, the conclusion of the affair stands as a decisive victory for Horde forces in the area. The outcome serves as an explicit warning to the Alliance that any territorial encroachment along the coast will meet immediate resistance.
sections.title: A Warning to the Alliance

summary: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected centers on escalating coastal tensions between the Horde and the Alliance following the suspicious destruction of a roadside tavern. The incident delivers a firm warning to Alliance forces while leaving unanswered questions about who truly threatened a vital civilian trade route.
attribution: In-game quest text: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
